name: Dal Makhani
ingredients_raw: Water, Black gram, Cream (Milk) (6.5%), Onion, Red Kidney Beans, Tomato Paste, Sunflower Oil, Butter (Milk, Salt) (1.5%), Cashewnut, Ginger, Salt, Coriander leaves, Garlic, Chilli Powder, Spices (Anistar, Black Cardamom, Black Pepper, Caraway, Cassia, Chilli, Clove, Salt, Coriander, Cumin, Dry Ginger, Fennel Seeds), Green Chilli, Turmeric Powder, Cardamom, Cinnamon, Clove. CONTAINS: MILK & CASHEWNUT Processed in a facility that also processes tree nuts, peanuts, soya, mustard and sesame.
